body: A self-hostable platform for building scripts, workflows, apps, and AI agents.
plain_description: **Build and automate business workflows, apps, and AI agents on one platform.** Business teams can create with AI while engineers review changes before they ship. Scripts can become shareable interfaces, APIs, and scheduled jobs.
technical_description: Windmill is an open-source, self-hostable code-first platform for workflows, apps, and AI agents. Scripts written in 20+ languages can be composed into flows, data pipelines, agents, and full-code React or Svelte apps; they can also generate UIs, API endpoints, and CLI commands. It provides a web IDE, visual flow editor, Git sync, review and promotion between environments, and isolated workers. Self-hosting options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and cloud providers.
title: Windmill
